items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I send for them... Louis had me to get the band together.

ctx.x: Now, you also did -- I think maybe at a later session, 'Sweet Sue,' which is a very funny record. Whose idea was that?

Now, that was Bud Johnson's. And of course, Louis would say -- no, Bud Johnson would say, (musical sounds), and Louis would interpret it, say -- they call themselves talking the viper mixer's language.
